services.description: Hybrid BM25 + dense retrieval over 1,962 real upcoming ASU campus events, plus mock RSVPs.

tools.name: search_events
tools.description: Search real upcoming ASU campus events by what the student is interested in, in plain language.

query.description: What the student is looking for, in their own words.

days_ahead.description: How many days ahead to look. Defaults to 21.

type.description: Optional event type filter, e.g. Workshop, Meeting, Social.

limit.description: How many events to return. Defaults to 5.

tools.name: get_event_details
tools.description: Fetch the full details of one ASU event by its id.

tools.name: reserve_spot
tools.description: Hold a mock RSVP for one ASU event on behalf of a signed-in student.

event_id.description: The id of the event to reserve.
